SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.project_id AS projectId, o.session_id AS sessionId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, v.venue_name AS venueName, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, ( SELECT q.delivery_mode FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id = b.quote_id WHERE b.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1 ) AS deliveryMode, item_stat.skuSummary AS skuSummary, item_stat.totalQuantity AS totalQuantity, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime, o.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(ticket_stat.ticket_count, 0) AS ticketCount, ( SELECT et2.ticket_id FROM electronic_ticket et2 WHERE et2.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE et2.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et2.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS defaultTicketId, ( SELECT et3.ticket_status FROM electronic_ticket et3 WHERE et3.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE et3.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et3.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS ticketStatus, CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' THEN 'CONTINUE_PAY' WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' THEN 'VIEW_TICKET' WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND COALESCE(ticket_stat.unused_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'VIEW_TICKET' WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND COALESCE(ticket_stat.ticket_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ticket_stat.generating_count, 0) = COALESCE(ticket_stat.ticket_count, 0) THEN 'TICKETING' ELSE 'NONE' END AS actionType FROM ticket_order o JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN ( SELECT order_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sku_name, ' x', quantity) ORDER BY order_item_id SEPARATOR '；') AS skuSummary, SUM(quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_stat ON item_stat.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(ticket_id) AS ticket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unused_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generating_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count FROM electronic_ticket GROUP BY order_id ) ticket_stat ON ticket_stat.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.project_id AS projectId, o.session_id AS sessionId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, ( SELECT q.delivery_mode FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id = b.quote_id WHERE b.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1 ) AS deliveryMode, o.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, o.service_fee_amount AS serviceFeeAmount, o.delivery_fee_amount AS deliveryFeeAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime, o.pay_time AS payTime, o.cancel_time AS cancelTime, o.ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime, o.finish_time AS finishTime, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime, ( SELECT et2.ticket_id FROM electronic_ticket et2 WHERE et2.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE et2.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et2.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS defaultTicketId, CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' THEN 'VIEW_TICKET' WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket et WHERE et.order_id = o.order_id AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED') THEN 'VIEW_TICKET' WHEN o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket et WHERE et.order_id = o.order_id AND et.ticket_status = 'GENERATING') THEN 'TICKETING' ELSE 'NONE' END AS ticketActionType FROM ticket_order o JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_id AS orderId, sku_id AS skuId, sku_name AS skuName, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity AS quantity, subtotal_amount AS subtotalAmount FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC

SELECT order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, order_id AS orderId, real_name AS realName, certificate_type AS certificateType, certificate_no AS certificateNo, phone AS phone FROM order_audience WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_audience_id ASC

SELECT order_address_id AS orderAddressId, order_id AS orderId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province AS province, city AS city, district AS district, detail_address AS detailAddress, CONCAT(province, city, district, detail_address) AS fullAddress FROM order_address WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT et.ticket_id AS ticketId, et.ticket_no AS ticketNo, et.order_id AS orderId, et.order_item_id AS orderItemId, et.order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, et.ticket_status AS ticketStatus, et.qr_code_value AS qrCodeValue, et.seat_info AS seatInfo, et.generate_time AS generateTime, et.check_time AS checkTime, et.expire_time AS expireTime, et.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, oa.real_name AS audienceName FROM electronic_ticket et LEFT JOIN order_audience oa ON oa.order_audience_id = et.order_audience_id WHERE et.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY CASE et.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et.ticket_id ASC

SELECT refund_id AS refundId, refund_no AS refundNo, order_id AS orderId, refund_type_snapshot AS refundTypeSnapshot, fee_rate_snapshot AS feeRateSnapshot, apply_time AS applyTime, reason AS reason, refund_amount AS refundAmount, fee_amount AS feeAmount, refund_status AS refundStatus, refund_time AS refundTime, fail_reason AS failReason FROM refund_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
